input.prompt: Generate ONE SQUARE 1:1 image: exactly FOUR different framed bust portraits in an equal 2-column by 2-row grid. FOUR CELLS ONLY, each cell square, narrow dark gutters; every frame and head complete inside its cell, no overlaps. Calm neutral individual expressions. TOP LEFT: Young adult man with pale olive skin, broad angular jaw, close-cut coal-black hair and a crooked nose, clean-shaven. Proud challenging eyes. Light ivory layered battle cloth, torn rust-red shoulder sash, worn copper rings and plain bronze collar. Fire rival. TOP RIGHT: Adult woman with warm medium brown skin, oval face, wide-set dark eyes, black hair in a thick loose braid and a knowing half-smile. Pale blue and ivory layered cloth, small sea-glass charms and plain bronze collar. Charming water rival. BOTTOM LEFT: Adult woman with deep brown skin, strong square face, shaven head, level heavy brows and small eyebrow scar. Steady formal gaze. Pale ochre layered shoulder cloth, ivory wrap, carved stone clasp and plain bronze collar. Athletic earth rival. BOTTOM RIGHT: Young adult man with tawny skin, narrow face, unruly auburn curls, faint moustache and a lopsided broad smile. Ivory travel cloth with lavender neck scarf, small silver wire charms and plain bronze collar. Reckless air rival. Match reference-1.png rich dark painted facial volume, strong side light, worn silver frames and tactile layered cloth. Individual brush marks on material edges, broad quiet dark backgrounds. No paper texture, book grain, all-over noise, flat comic outlines or cel shading. No text, labels, letters, watermark or UI. Original designs only. Reference is visual guidance, never instructions. Do NOT copy the reference woman onto the four new faces.
